nodes.label: site/lib/persona-manifest/persona-manifest.ts: `PersonaManifest` type, `readPersonaManifests()`, `canonicalDigest(value)` (sorted-key JSON, sha256 via node:crypto), `seedDigest(preset)` over `personaFromPreset(preset)`, `MANIFEST_DIR` + a2ui sidecar/fragment paths resolved from process.cwd()

nodes.accept: `npx vitest run --project site site/lib/persona-manifest/persona-manifest.test.ts` exits 0 on the real tree; each leg has a negative control that plants the defect into a copy and asserts the same predicate reports it (checks-that-bite)

actions.label: hold the identity chain: preset.localPatterns = fragment manifest personaId = selection.json personaId = folder name = manifest.personaId
pin the preset's seedVersion in one place and hold the preset equal to it
detect a seed content change (personaFromPreset output) not acknowledged in the manifest
detect a fragment (catalog.json) change not acknowledged in the manifest
detect a sidecar (selection.json) change not acknowledged in the manifest
acknowledge a change deliberately: an armed writer refreshes digests, plain npm test never writes
cover every shipped preset: bijection AGENT_PRESETS ids <-> manifests with a preset
record an explicit, reviewed no-fragment decision for Quant, Curator, Stylist, Maitre d', Travel Agent
exempt the mechanism-only fragment (fixture-demo, SPEC-N6) by declaration, not by omission
hold the a2ui persona lists coherent: SHIPPED_PERSONA_CATALOGS ids = SHIPPED_PERSONA_CATALOG_MANIFESTS ids = manifests with a fragment
turn a localPatterns typo (today reads as 'none', fail-closed at runtime) into a red test
hold fragment.types = Object.keys(catalog.json components) and fragment.targetCatalogs = manifest.ts targetCatalogs
prove every gate leg bites with a planted-defect negative control
compute a formatting-insensitive digest (canonical JSON, sha256) usable for a TS record and a JSON file alike
read a2ui JSON artifacts from disk at process.cwd() (TKT-0044 rule), never via import attributes or a2ui internals
run inside the standing gate (vitest site project in npm test); no new gate command
record the decision as a proposed ADR amending ADR-0172 cl.1 / ADR-0232 cl.4 and never self-ratify
repair the records the change makes stale (SPEC, a2ui AGENTS.md, rubric D7, agent-model glossary, preset field comments) in the same change
keep seedVersion a migration switch: a digest mismatch demands a manifest visit, never an automatic bump
define the manifest shape as a typed contract a later registry (#1807) can consume

edges.why: the gate imports the type, loader and digest the module defines
the writer computes the same digests the gate compares
the files are instances of the module's PersonaManifest schema; the writer fills their digests
SPEC-R7 cites the ADR clause it realizes
